current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: Mostly cloudy. Low around 71, with temperatures rising to around 73 overnight. South wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Slight Chance Rain Showers then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of rain showers between 9am and 10am, then a slight chance of showers and thunderstorms between 1pm and 5pm. Partly sunny. High near 86, with temperatures falling to around 84 in the afternoon. South wind 5 to 15 mph, with gusts as high as 30 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 10am, then showers and thunderstorms likely between 10am and noon, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms between noon and 4pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 82. Northwest wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Friday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms. Cloudy, with a high near 77. East wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 80%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of rain showers before 7am, then showers and thunderstorms likely. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 81. South wind 0 to 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms likely. Partly sunny, with a high near 84. South wind 5 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Monday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 1pm, then a slight chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny, with a high near 82. North wind around 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Tuesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Sunny, with a high near 79. Northeast wind 5 to 10 mph.
